image_description: A side-profile view of a cottontail rabbit sitting upright on rocky, dry ground with sparse vegetation. The rabbit has greyish-brown fur, long ears with dark tips and visible pink inner ear skin, large dark eyes, and a short white tail. Its hind legs are tucked beneath its body, and forelegs are partially visible supporting its posture.
